satellite.method: Raw cache masks independently reconstructed; vectorized weighted sums replace production dot products.

buoys.matching_method: Double-precision unit-sphere KD-tree candidates followed by frozen-precision spherical reranking independently replace all-pairs search; every record and nearest-cell assignment reproduces. Stored float32 cell-angle conversion is preserved at near bisectors.
buoys.weighting_method: Inverse platform-day count and inverse daily platform count; bincount sums independently replace hierarchical grouped averages.

scope: Independent implementation of extraction, matching and score arithmetic; not independent acquisition, a new observation source, or evidence of latent-truth independence.
